Day 5 of 20 days of toddler lunch ideas 🤍

If you’re tired of constantly thinking about what to make for lunch, this series is for you.

Today’s lunch: carrot mac & cheese + blackberries + avocado

A comforting, low-effort meal that works perfectly for busy days.

Why this meal works:

• Carrots → provide vitamin A, supporting vision, immune health, and growth

• Egg → provides high-quality protein and choline, supporting brain development

• Cheese & heavy cream → provide calcium and fat to support healthy growth

• Pasta → provides carbohydrates for energy

• Blackberries → provide fiber and antioxidants

• Avocado → provides healthy fats that support brain development

Meals like this help keep things simple while still offering balanced nutrition 🤍
